notes.title: Update March 2020. Coronavirus!
notes.content:
Wanna know what it feels like to have coronavirus without actually getting it?
Here's your chance to see what the whole fuss is about and prevent the spread of the infection in Hell!
This is a free demo version of the game that includes one level and a boss fight. We changed the plot and the dialogues in the demo a little to follow the trend. Oh yeah, one more thing: just chill, bro! Remember it's just a game, so don't take it too seriously! Take care!

notes.title: RELEASED! RELEASED! RELEASED!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31014526/62af5b752bfc4eefef94d3c90db7780950361d2c.jpg[/img]

Hell just got a deadly new diabolic avenger, as BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre from developer and publisher Big Way Games has arrived on the PC today!

BDSM is a satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son as he battles a horrific human invasion of Hell. Grab your guns, stock up on milk — and save Hell! While you’re at it, rescue the awesome demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

Features of BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre include:
[list][*] A hilarious story feating Lou, Satan’s son, as he attempts to save Hell! Defeat those meddlesome humans who’ve invaded the fiery pit, and send those mega-corporation stooges back to earth while you’re at it!
[/list][list][*] Explore spectacular locations, destroy everything in them while you battle epic bosses and relentless minion hordes
[/list][list][*] Guns, gore...and milk all take center stage as Lou’s implements of destruction
[/list][list][*] Save the demoness, save the (hell)world — those evil mega-corp fiends have captured your friend so show them what “giving ‘em hell” really means[/list]

About Big Way Games, the developers of this game:
Big Way Games Studio was founded in March 2015 as a collective of several development teams working on a mix of projects. Spread out across multiple territories, the Big Way team shares a common goal — to make the most unique games possible.

notes.title: Locations of the game
notes.content:
[h1][b]Strip club “Purple Rapture”[/b][/h1]
Almost immediately after the seizure, people began to open strip clubs and brothels throughout hell. Profits grew, many were ready to pay a huge amount per night or at least an hour with a charming succubus. “Purple Rapture” is famous for being one of the largest and oldest establishments of its kind.
